Welcome. 
 
Thank you for downloading our app. Please first read instructions to know how to use this app: 
 
Shake your phone to shake the spray image. Touch anywhere on screen to start spray. Have a good fun! 

How can you prank your friends?: Start spray simulator. Come to your friend's car. Shake your phone few times (like shaking a can before spraying). Aim your phone at the car and press any place on the screen of your phone. Spry will start spraying on the screen of your phone and produce a realistic sound, making your friend think you have a real can with spray. 
 
This app uses Android-Color-Picker (https://github.com/chiralcode/Android-Color-Picker) library distributed under apache 2.0 License (http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html)
